name: Belvís de la Jara (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided sky blue over red with a green triangle at the hoist, charged at the centre with a yellow bee.
history: The flag consists of two horizontal stripes and a sharp triangle whose base issues from the hoist and whose apex reaches the centre of the flag; the colours symbolise the past and present of Belvís, the upper stripe being sky blue, the lower red and the triangle green, with a golden bee at the centre.

features.role: sharp triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
